title: 2022 Topps #1 Series One Shohei Ohtani Los Angeles Angels Of Anaheim MLB
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a one-of-a-kind 2022 Topps Series One sports trading card featuring Shohei Ohtani, a Major League Baseball player for the Los Angeles Angels. The card is part of the #1 Series and is perfect for collectors who want to add a unique item to their collection. It is not autographed and is manufactured by Topps. 

The card is ideal for fans of the sport and collectors alike, and is a great addition to any collection. With its sleek design and high-quality printing, it is sure to impress. Don't miss out on the chance to own this rare and coveted card.
